overlap_rule: Confirmed exact/reused/same-scene relations form connected components; components cannot cross splits. Unresolved risk relations remain quarantined or excluded, not declared independent.
independence_rule: May be supported by footage geometry/context, temporal coverage, multiple comparison methods and scoped human observation. Absence of pHash/ORB matches alone is insufficient; metadata is optional corroboration.
small_subset: Technical pilot candidates must be separated from formal study acceptance; >=1000 VN labelled frames is a proposal-level dataset target, not permission to claim an arbitrary small validation scope is representative.
activation: Requires explicit protocol acceptance; no production gates modified by this proposal.
